regions.full_page: I hope you are well -- you and all your dear ones. Many thanks for your recent favors. I hope that someday you'll just wake up and start to live for God one day at a time, forgeting the fickleness of creatures -- especially if they figure on getting "a nest in this world where they can find true happiness." The only tree in which to find place to build such a nest, is the Church that pro- vides the material to build in untold graces from God -- all sizes -- with crosses for cement. Without such cement no one on earth can get very far with anything like getting a little taste of Heaven in this world. So let us not take it over serious when trials and disapoint- ments-from whatever source-catch us sleeping. In other words it never pays to become discouraged-at the faults of others or at our own. The sooner we come to realize our own stupidity and unworthyness of the blessings surrounding our whole life and in which we are immurged -- the air we breathe, the light of the heavens we enjoy by night and by day and all movies of visible creation. (All in the natural) To say nothing of the unseen, the supernatural !-- the sooner we'll find peace.
